rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the professional practice of midwifery.

example.english: This hospital's midwifery service has always been popular with expectant mothers.
example.traditional: 呢間醫院嘅助產服務一向好受孕婦歡迎。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 ge3 zo6 caan2 fuk6 mou6 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 sau6 jan6 fu5 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use this for the practical skill or technique of helping with childbirth, rather than the profession as a whole.

example.english: The teacher demonstrated traditional midwifery in class.
example.traditional: 老師喺堂上示範傳統接生術。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 hai2 tong4 soeng6 si6 faan6 cyun4 tung2 zip3 saang1 seot6

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to midwifery as an academic subject or body of scientific knowledge.

example.english: They majored in midwifery at university and became a midwife after graduating.
example.traditional: 佢大學主修助產學，畢業後做助產士。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 hok6 zyu2 sau1 zo6 caan2 hok6 bat1 jip6 hau6 zou6 zo6 caan2 si6
